name: Mindful Circle Vietnam
description: Cong dong chia se kien thuc ve suc khoe tinh than, thoi quen phuc hoi va cach tu cham soc ban than hang ngay.
rules: Ton trong nhau, khong spam, khong phan xet, noi chuyen truoc khi chia se noi dung nay cam.

groupReports.reason: Noi dung chia se co chieu huong qua cai le, can xem lai cach kiem duyet bai viet.

groupLogs.content: Cap nhat mo ta nhom va bo sung quyen kiem duyet bai viet.
Moi thanh vien moi tham gia chu de phuc hoi sau sang chan.

name: Midnight Coders Club
description: Noi ve code, bug, architecture va tinh than song sot trong nhung dem deadline.
rules: Tap trung vao chia se kinh nghiem, khong flame war, khong spam AI-generated nhay cam.

groupReports.reason: Mot so thao luan ve bug dang bi de nham thanh cãi nhau qua gay gat.

groupLogs.content: Bat che do duyet bai viet cho cac chu de confidence thap.
Nang cap thanh vien thanh moderator de co them quyen kiem duyet.

name: Morning Run & Recovery
description: Nhom cho nguoi yeu van dong nhe, chay bo buoi sang va phuc hoi nhan thuc sau tap.
rules: Khuyen khich van dong an toan, chia se tran thanh, khong ap luc thanh tich.

groupLogs.content: Dieu chinh thong diep nhom de tap trung vao phuc hoi va van dong nhe.
Them thanh vien moi co kinh nghiem chay bo buoi sang.

name: Design Therapy Lab
description: Khong gian chia se ve UI, branding, tipography va routine de giam burnout.
rules: Nhan xet co can cu, uu tien chia se screen va feedback mang tinh xay dung.

groupLogs.content: Tat che do moi thanh vien tu moi nguoi khac, chi owner moi co the moi.
Duyet bai chia se ve hue sac va layout he thong.

name: Study With Me After Dark
description: Nhom dong hanh hoc tap va chia se routine tap trung cho hoc sinh, sinh vien, nguoi di lam.
rules: Giu im lang lap, khong lan man, khong spam link va phai ton trong nhung nguoi dang can tap trung.

groupReports.reason: Mot so bai viet hoc tap co noi dung khong phu hop voi muc dich on tap tai lieu.

groupLogs.content: Chinh lai lich hoc va quy dinh dang bai theo khung gio tap trung.
Duyet yeu cau tham gia cua thanh vien moi co khung hoc tap on dinh.

name: Photo Walk Society
description: Nhom di bo chup anh, chia se bo cuc, mau sac va cau chuyen dang sau tung khung hinh.
rules: Chia se anh va cau chuyen co chu y, khong lech chu de, khong repost khong ghi nguon.

groupLogs.content: Tinh chinh quy dinh chia se anh de giu chat luong album chung.
Gui loi moi toi mot thanh vien co nhieu anh du lich dep.

name: Family Support Hub
description: Noi an toan cho cha me, nguoi cham soc va nhung ai muon noi ve ap luc gia dinh.
rules: Bao mat noi dung, khong chia se thong tin nhay cam cua nguoi khac, uu tien su ton trong.

groupReports.reason: Xuat hien mot vai binh luan nay cam can duoc xu ly som de giu an toan cho nhom.

groupLogs.content: Bo sung huong dan trao doi ve tam ly va cham soc gia dinh.
Tam khoa mot tai khoan co hanh vi kich dong trong luong chat rieng.

name: Music Healing Room
description: Nghe nhac, chia se playlist, va dung am nhac de giup nhau on dinh cam xuc.
rules: Chia se ban nhac co chu de ro rang, ton trong ban quyen va khong noi xau gu am nhac cua nguoi khac.

groupLogs.content: Cap nhat playlist chu de va bo sung quy tac chia se am nhac.
Moi mot thanh vien co khau vi am nhac da dang tham gia.

name: Vegan Kitchen Stories
description: Cong dong nau an chay, chia se cong thuc, va benh vuc mot nhap song cham, lanh.
rules: Uu tien cong thuc de lam, ngon, la va co nguon ro rang. Khong tranh luan gay gat ve cach an.

groupReports.reason: Mot so cong thuc co noi dung khong ro nguon va can duoc dieu chinh lai phan trich dan.

groupLogs.content: Chinh lai bo quy tac ve nguon goc cong thuc va cach gui anh thuc an.
Tu choi mot bai viet khong ro nguon va co noi dung lap lai.

name: Pet Companions Corner
description: Noi chia se ve vat nuoi, cham soc, cung voi nhung ngay co the thuong phai can su nguoi.
rules: Khong dang noi dung gay soc, giu an toan cho nguoi yeu dong vat va khong khai thac thu cung sai muc dich.

groupLogs.content: Bo sung quy tac ve su an toan khi chia se hinh anh thu cung.
Cap nhat quyen cua admin de them van de duyet loi moi.
